read.thesis: Margin up 90bp to 6.8% on timing-aided commercial recoveries; FY EBIT margin guide narrowed to 6.3–6.5% with sales cut on China, and management flags commercial turning negative in Q4 with commodity headwind of 50bp.

capex.quote: CapEx to be approximately $1.5 billion compared to our previous range of $1.5-1.6 billion.

triggers.label: FCF guide raised $75M at midpoint
triggers.quote: we are raising our free cash flow outlook to between $1.85 billion and $1.9 billion

triggers.label: Commodity headwind 50bp, not recovered yet
triggers.quote: Higher commodity costs reduced margins by about 50 basis points.

triggers.label: Q4 commercial items flipping negative
triggers.quote: commercial probably flipping negative on us in Q4

triggers.label: Production outlook softer for 2027
triggers.quote: Kind of seems to be a little bit softer.

guidance.quote: We are narrowing our outlook for adjusted EBIT margin to a range of between 6.3% and 6.5%.
The midpoint, which is unchanged at $7 per share, represents an increase of 22% versus last year.
we are raising our free cash flow outlook to between $1.85 billion and $1.9 billion
we are revising our full-year sales outlook, primarily to reflect our assumption for lower vehicle production in China
we expect a lower adjusted tax rate of approximately 22% compared to 23% previously
we expect CapEx to be approximately $1.5 billion compared to our previous range of $1.5-1.6 billion.

guidance.value: flattish all-in, up 1% ex Complete Vehicles
guidance.quote: for the full year, we are probably looking at closer to flattish all in and up 1% excluding Complete Vehicles.

prior_guidance_check.quote: We're kind of tracking more towards 50 this year from the margin benefit.
we had talked at that time that it was north of $450 million. We got probably a little bit more in Q3

red_flags.label: Margin lift from timing of commercial recoveries
red_flags.quote: some favorable commercial items moved forward from Q4

red_flags.label: Commodity recoveries lagging, DRAM escalating
red_flags.quote: The bigger thing that is really continuing to escalate, probably the biggest driver behind what we saw in the second half has been the DRAM

evasions.quote: I will not put a number on it, but I would still say it is early innings.
Right now, it would be premature to put numbers on it.
